info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector TestRun API
TestRun
Microsoft Azure Get All Test Runs For The Given Filters

params.name: api-version
params.description: The API version to use for this operation.

params.name: orderby
params.description:
Sort on the supported fields in (field asc/desc) format. eg: executedDateTime
asc. Supported fields - executedDateTime

params.name: search
params.description:
Prefix based, case sensitive search on searchable fields - description,
executedUser. For example, to search for a test run, with description 500 VUs,
the search parameter can be 500.

params.name: testId
params.description: Unique name of an existing load test.

params.name: executionFrom
params.description: Start DateTime(RFC 3339 literal format) of test-run execution time filter range.

params.name: executionTo
params.description: End DateTime(RFC 3339 literal format) of test-run execution time filter range.

params.name: status
params.description: Comma separated list of test run status.

params.name: maxpagesize
params.description: Number of results in response.

items.docs: Get all test runs for the given filters.

info.name: Microsoft Azure Get All Client Metrics For A Given Load Test Run

params.name: testRunId
params.description: Unique identifier for load test run name, must be a valid URL character ^[a-z0-9_-]*$

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter to be used in metrics queries, filters can be applied on following fields : request, error, percentile( possible values : 90, 99, 95) or time (can be between start and end time). Request and error filter values can be get from /clientMetricsFilter API. Example of filter : (request eq 'HTTP Request1' or request eq 'total-4bec6d5b-c3c3-4f5f-be09-5c4abb28aedd') and (error eq 'Non HTTP response code: org.apache.http.conn.ConnectTimeoutException' or error eq 'total-4bec6d5b-c3c3-4f5f-be09-5c4abb28aedd') and (percentile eq 90) and (time ge 1626346535054 and time le 1626346924744)

params.name: groupByInterval
params.description: Group by time interval, in which interval metrics needs to be retrieved, values can be 10s,20s,30s,1m,2m,5m,1h

params.description: Api version
